findings.summary: General C05 thread mutation fence depends on deriving a record-only C06 confirmation scope.
findings.trigger: An authenticated C05 section has a primary record plus document/calculation/receipt evidence. createReviewAnswerSource.resolve calls answerMaterial, which rejects every non-record reference, so valid create/reply/edit operations fail even with current full access.
findings.requested_change: Prepare the review pin/current-ACL/source lease independently of ConfirmationScope derivation. Keep the C06 refusal for unrepresentable confirmation scopes, but do not apply it to general conversations.
findings.resolution: The WP08 wrapper now captures source.prepareThreadFence and its returned closure. WP07 prepareThreadFence reads the authenticated full review and invokes prepareAccess without calling answerMaterial or deriving ConfirmationScope. Its closure pins request/provider/access methods and exact protected review digest before/after waits. Non-record references are not filtered by this general method.
findings.limits: The available real fixture exercises record evidence. No real WP06 document/calculation producer witness was available, so non-record integration remains an explicit hosted/integration qualification limit rather than a fabricated positive test.

findings.summary: Thread mutation still dereferences the C05 recipient commit check dynamically and tests prepared-fence identity before, rather than after, its await.
findings.trigger: The options checkReviewRecipientAtCommit method changes during the human/review fence await, or prepareReviewThreadFence changes during its returned fence await. A subsequent check can use the replacement instead of the prepared operation provider.
findings.requested_change: Capture commit check and prepare method per operation, invoke captured methods, and compare identities after the last awaited fence before synchronous mutation.
findings.resolution: Each create/change captures the recipient commit check, passes it explicitly to checkThreadRecipient, rejects replacement, and compares prepareReviewThreadFence after the awaited prepared fence. Recipient actions/history also pin callbacks and order human authorization before final fences.

findings.summary: A second observation under the same scope/basis/UI request could overwrite the first observation's provider lease.
findings.trigger: Observe A, replace prepareAccess while keeping material digests equal, observe B under the same binding, then fence A. The former Map key found B's current callback for A.
findings.resolution: Every observation receives a private random accessLeaseRef. The Map entry binds that token to authorityScopeDigest, full observation digest, exact review digest and the original callback/provider identity. A newer observation cannot replace A's slot. Token is excluded from source/dependency/scope fingerprints, baseline and command digest; the HTTP preparation route emits an explicit projection that excludes it.
findings.test_source: test/product/wp07/review-thread-context.test.ts: second observation cannot rebind first; checks equal material fingerprints, distinct tokens, fence A false / B true and tamper false. Test source inspected only; hosted pass pending.

findings.summary: A second recipient authorization using the same authenticated context could replace the provider lease of an operation waiting to commit.
findings.trigger: Prepare recipient authorization for operation A, replace checkAtCommit on the provider, and reauthorize the same recipient/full basis with the exact same TrustedDomainContext before A enters C08. The former binding-keyed Map overwrote the slot and A could use the new permissive check.
findings.resolution: Use a WeakMap keyed by the authentic context object, with an inner Map keyed by recipient, full basis and binding. A populated slot cannot be replaced with different proof, authorize or check method identities. Recheck current provider and existing slot after the last await and before first insertion. At 512 entries reject a new slot instead of evicting a possibly active lease. The commit path invokes the original synchronous checkAtCommit and checks identity on both sides; no authorization boolean is cached.

test_source.assessment: The existing real SQLite/admitted context fixture calls the same collaboration authority instance outside C08 after replacing checkAtCommit, using the exact same context as the pending thread create. The regression asserts that reauthorization is false, mutation fails without echoing the submitted body and the storage version is unchanged. This is source inspection; it has not been run by this reviewer.
